summary: Bloomin' Brands filed an 8-K reporting that on September 25, 2026, it and co-borrower OSI Restaurant Partners entered a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo as administrative agent, amending and restating the September 19, 2024 facility. The revolver matures September 25, 2031, with commitment amounts, pricing and leverage covenants substantially unchanged; a new Consolidated Senior Secured Net Leverage Ratio covenant of 3.50 to 1.00 was added alongside the existing 4.50 to 1.00 Total Net Leverage Ratio. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
